original_datasets.name: final_data

summary_statistics.info: 2293 rows, 19 columns. Types: firm_id (object), 18 numeric float32 columns including complaints_2008, num_names_2008, first_A, ad_spend_k, emp_size, total_price, etc.

original_datasets.notes: Local file is required at /app/data/final_data.dta for execution. first_A is coded as a binary indicator. Price-related variables are available only for a subset (n≈543).

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Standardize complaints and number of names, then regress standardized complaints on an indicator for names starting with A or a number and standardized number of names.
preprocessing_steps: Ensure complaints_2008, num_names_2008, and first_A are numeric.
Recode first_A into a two-level categorical: 'A or number' vs 'rest'.
Drop rows with missing values in model variables.

key_choices.outcome_measure: Standardized number of BBB complaints in 2008 (z-score of complaints_2008).
key_choices.main_predictor_measure: Indicator for firm name starts with 'A' or a number (first_A==1).
key_choices.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for variables used in the model.
key_choices.data_processing: Recode binary indicator for first_A, z-transform outcome and num_names_2008.
key_choices.inference_rule: p-value from the coefficient on first_A; threshold not_stated.

outcome.name: complaints_z
outcome.definition: Z-score of complaints_2008 (standardized within the analysis sample).

main_predictor.name: first_A_cat
main_predictor.definition: Categorical indicator whether the firm name starts with 'A' or a number vs 'rest' (derived from first_A).

controls.name: num_names_z
controls.definition: Z-score of num_names_2008 (number of names the company used in 2008).

analysis_code.notes: Reads /app/data/final_data.dta. Writes /app/data/results_task1.json with OLS summary and the first_A effect.

tasks.notes_for_agent: Follow this planned path; do not change the focal claim, dataset, or analysis goal.

tasks.task_instruction: Use only Illinois plumbing firms. Do not restrict to metro Chicago. Do not include Yelp, Angie’s List, or Consumer’s Checkbook reviews. Use overall complaints, not complaints per employee.

analysis_path.path_description: Standardize complaints and number of names, regress standardized complaints on first_A and standardized number of names, and report the F-test for the first_A term.
preprocessing_steps: Ensure complaints_2008, num_names_2008, and first_A are numeric.
Recode first_A into a two-level categorical: 'A or number' vs 'rest'.
Drop rows with missing values in model variables.

key_choices.outcome_measure: Standardized number of BBB complaints in 2008 (z-score of complaints_2008).
key_choices.main_predictor_measure: Indicator for firm name starts with 'A' or a number (first_A==1).
key_choices.sample_restriction: All Illinois plumbing firms in the dataset; no metro Chicago restriction.
key_choices.missing_data_rule: Listwise deletion for variables used in the model.
key_choices.data_processing: Recode binary indicator for first_A, z-transform outcome and num_names_2008.
key_choices.model_choice: linear regression (OLS) with nested-model F-test for first_A.
key_choices.inference_rule: F-test for first_A term (compare full vs reduced model without first_A).

outcome.name: complaints_z
outcome.definition: Z-score of complaints_2008 (standardized within the analysis sample).

main_predictor.name: first_A_cat
main_predictor.definition: Categorical indicator whether the firm name starts with 'A' or a number vs 'rest' (derived from first_A).

controls.name: num_names_z
controls.definition: Z-score of num_names_2008 (number of names the company used in 2008).

analysis_code.notes: Reads /app/data/final_data.dta. Writes /app/data/results_task2.json including F statistic, df, and p-value for first_A.

tasks.notes_for_agent: Use the planned linear regression with F-test. Do not include review-site variables or restrict to metro Chicago.

files.data/analysis_task1__py.py: Python translation of Task1. Runs OLS: complaints_z ~ C(first_A_cat) + num_names_z. Saves JSON results to /app/data/results_task1.json.
files.data/analysis_task2__py.py: Python translation of Task2. Runs OLS and computes nested-model F-test for first_A term. Saves JSON results to /app/data/results_task2.json.

codebase.notes: Original R scripts (data/analysis_task1.R, data/analysis_task2.R) are present but not executed. Python rewrites ensure IO under /app/data and preserve the modeling and inference logic.

analysis.instructions: Execute Task1 and Task2 using the original dataset final_data.dta, saving structured outputs to /app/data/results_task1.json and /app/data/results_task2.json.
not_allowed_actions: replace the planned path with a different analysis path

debugging_rule.repair_scope: fix dependency, file path, or output extraction issues only; do not redesign the analysis.

analysis.comparison_metrics: Task1: coefficient and p-value for first_A effect from OLS with num_names control. Task2: F statistic, df1, df2, and p-value for the first_A term; also standardized coefficient for first_A.
